headline: Parliamentary Committee Proposes Mandatory 'Hug-to-Handshake' Conversion Chart for Lawmakers
body:
A specially appointed Parliamentary Subcommittee on Physical Greetings has unveiled a 40-page technical manual designed to regulate interpersonal contact within the Lok Sabha. The document, which includes detailed geometric diagrams for appropriate arm-angle positioning during floor confrontations, suggests that all future non-verbal interactions be categorized as either 'Strategic Pat', 'Aggressive Embrace', or 'Constitutional Handshake'.

'We noticed that the lack of standardized protocol was leading to significant confusion regarding the emotional intent behind legislative physical gestures,' said Rameshwar Singh, the Joint Secretary of the Bureau of Formal Etiquette. 'Under the new guidelines, if a member wishes to express disagreement, they are encouraged to utilize a stiff, two-second nod instead of lunging for a hug, which the current rulebook classifies as an unauthorized display of tactical affection.'

To ensure compliance, the Speaker’s office will install motion-capture sensors near the aisles to flag any 'excessive lunging' or 'unprompted tactile proximity.' The committee noted that the guidelines are intended to foster a more predictable environment where members can focus on shouting over one another without the distracting uncertainty of whether a colleague is approaching to offer a hug or merely attempting to adjust their microphone.
caption: Lawmakers to undergo mandatory training on the difference between a hug and a political jibe. Parliament is finally formalizing the physics of the floor embrace. #Parliament #Etiquette #IndianPolitics (satire)
